definitions.visits: An arrival (a visit) is a LANDING: the first page a person opens arriving from outside (a search engine, a link, a chat). Pages they open afterwards are not arrivals.
definitions.unique_visitors: Distinct people (hashed IP) who opened any page, arriving or navigating. A creator's page report counts the same way, so it can never exceed this.
definitions.top_pages: Landings per page over the range. Every visit lands on exactly one page, so the 12 pages listed add up to less than the Arrivals total: the rest landed on pages further down the list.
definitions.requests: Every recorded request, landings and the navigation after them, so these numbers are larger than the arrival counts above. The areas add up to the total (request_totals); AI-agent requests here equal the AI-agent requests figure at the top.
definitions.areas: Other pages = pages that belong to none of the named areas (each page is filed by its first path segment, e.g. /company or /dead-coins). Rarely requested paths = the long tail of single paths beyond the 3,000 most requested. Everything else = all areas below the top 10 added together.
definitions.human_requests: A human request is a PAGE the person opened (a navigation); the calls a page makes in the background after it loads (/api/..., header, account and settings fetches) are not recorded as page views.
definitions.segments: Humans = requests with a non-bot user agent. AI agents = requests from a recognised AI agent, crawler or answer engine. Customer-participating = actions where a customer account is on at least one side (customer-to-customer and customer-to-platform fills both count; bots customers run on their own accounts count as customers) - participation, not proof of independent external volume; Platform-only = system, test, market-maker and internal accounts on every side (orders carry no agent flag, so actions split by account kind).
definitions.volume: Traded notional = price x quantity of every filled CLOB trade, in the pair's quote currency (USDC for */USDC pairs). A trade counts for customers when a customer account is on either side. Event cards = USDC of filled event-card orders.
